notes: Phenom site (refNum MASRUS, widgetApiEndpoint https://careers.mastercard.com/widgets). Search is a POST to that endpoint with ddoKey=refineSearch, global=true, clearAll=false, all_fields=[category,country,state,city,postalCode,jobType,phLocSlider], keywords and selected_fields. Facet keys and vocabularies are published in data.aggregations (country, city, state, orgFunction, type, category). Sort values come from the page's own select#sortselect (Most relevant / Most recent / Most popular) and travel in the body as sortBy. Unfiltered totalHits 935; keywords=engineer + category=[Engineering] -> 196, which is also the fixture the adapter posts (empty filters, clearAll=true).
